title: Writhing Haunt

[[Image:The Writhing Haunt.jpg|thumb|The Writhing Haunt]]
The '''Writhing Haunt''' is an area located in the western part of the [[Western Plaguelands]].  Originally the area was a life-sustaining farm, but it has since been overrun by the vile [[Scourge]]. In their quest to destroy the living, they have placed a large cauldron in the middle of the field which constantly spews disease-filled vapors into the air. The cauldron itself is protected by [[Cauldron Lord Razarch]].

You can find [[Mulgris Deepriver]], a quest giving NPC, hidden inside a house at the Writhing Haunt.
